comment: Generated by proto/go/zs TestRegistryCycleVectors. Times are Unix ms, 0 for never; an empty list or map is an unset field, as on a fresh chain row. context_windows projects each node's model capacities. carry: a cycle's rows (ops) after the last-good capabilities of prev, the previous snapshot (null for none), are carried onto them at now_ms. advertisable: whether the node surfaces on the discovery aggregates at now_ms. merge: saved_catalog is the persisted catalog as written, decoded (proto_version floored to minor 0) and merged into fresh, a boot's chain read; max_carry_age_ms 0 or negative takes the default. seed: what a boot whose chain read failed seeds from saved_catalog, each node's capabilities kept only within the carry window.

carry.name: an unprobed node inside the window takes its last-good capabilities and carry clock
a node probed up this cycle keeps its own
a node last good exactly max_carry_age ago has aged out
a node last good one millisecond inside max_carry_age carries
a node never confirmed live carries no capabilities, only its last probe attempt
a node down last cycle carries until its last success ages out, and its last attempt
a node aged out of the window still carries its last probe attempt
a probe attempt this cycle is kept over the last one
a probe-failed node keeps what it has and takes only what it lacks
a probe-failed node keeps its own model capacities
a probe-failed node keeps its own builtin tools
a probe-failed node keeps its own max_tool_iters
a probe-failed node keeps its own tool_headroom_per_iteration
a carry clock the row already has is kept
the carry is per node, not per operator
each node of a fleet is judged on its own

advertisable.name: a node probed up this cycle
a node probed down this cycle, however recent its last success
an unprobed node inside the carry window
an unprobed node exactly at the carry window's edge
an unprobed node one millisecond inside the edge
an unprobed node never confirmed live, whatever its reachable bit
a staging node the payer has not opted in to
a staging node the payer opted in to
a node that never said its proto_version
a node on another wire major
a node on this major at minor 0
a signer known to be below the routing floor
a signer exactly at the routing floor
a signer known to hold nothing

merge.name: a restart restores an unprobed node's saved capabilities, its proto minor floored
a saved node past the carry window is not restored
a node new on chain has nothing to restore
a saved node gone from the chain is dropped
a node the fresh read reached keeps its own
a zero max_carry_age takes the default window
a negative max_carry_age takes the default window
a shorter max_carry_age ages a saved node out sooner

seed.name: a saved node inside the carry window keeps its capabilities
a saved node past the carry window keeps only its identity
a saved node exactly at the window's edge has aged out
each saved node is judged on its own, in the file's order
a zero max_carry_age takes the default window
